# SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-zkasuran-SAND-1.0
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-finance-yield
protocol: generic
name: Finance reference 136
description: 'SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-zkasuran-SAND-1.0. Own observed
  Ethereum USDC base supply rates for Aave V3 and Compound V3. Current-rate APY uses
  per-second compounding over 365 days and excludes incentive rewards.'
base_url: https://telegraph-s2-hashprice.margyn.workers.dev
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
- path: /truth/v2/finance-yield
  external_path: /truth/v2/finance-yield
  method: GET
  description: Own observed Ethereum USDC base supply rates for Aave V3 and Compound
    V3. Current-rate APY uses per-second compounding over 365 days and excludes incentive
    rewards.
  intents:
  - CRYPTO_YIELD_RATE_GENERAL
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: project
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Lending protocol, e.g. aave-v3
      - name: symbol
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Asset of the pool, e.g. USDC
      - name: chain
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Chain of the pool, e.g. Ethereum
semantics:
  supported_intents:
  - CRYPTO_YIELD_RATE_GENERAL
intent_mapping:
  CRYPTO_YIELD_RATE_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /truth/v2/finance-yield
    input:
      project:
        from: project
      symbol:
        from: symbol
      chain:
        from: chain
    output:
      supply_apy:
        path: supply_apy
        unit: basis points
